title: ListConversations
description:
Action: `list_conversations`. Lists the caller's conversations for a history sidebar: those with at least one message, newest `updatedAt` first, ties broken by `conversationId` descending. The server applies the caller's org and user scope before paging and searching, so a page is never short because of scoping and a search can never reach a conversation the caller couldn't list. Page by feeding a response's `nextCursor` back as the next request's `cursor`. The server replies with an `immediate_response` event (`responseType` `Conversations`) whose `data` matches the `Response` schema below.

Keyset semantics under concurrent writes: pages are positions in the `(updatedAt, conversationId)` order, never offsets. A page never repeats a row an earlier page returned, and a row that is not updated while the client pages is never skipped. A row whose `updatedAt` moves while the client pages jumps ABOVE the cursor, so the remaining pages do not return it; it heads a fresh first page instead. Clients merge pages by `conversationId`.

Request.title: ListConversationsRequest
Request.description: Fields sent by the client to page through or search its conversations. With no `cursor` and no `query` this is the original first-page listing.

requestId.description: Client-generated correlation ID echoed back on the response.

limit.description: Maximum number of conversations in this page. Must be 1–200; defaults to 50. Servers clamp a larger value to 200 rather than rejecting it, so a client from before paging that asked for more still gets a page (and pages the rest with `nextCursor`).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's `nextCursor`, issued for the same `query`. Returns only conversations after the one it names in the listing order. Omit (or send an empty string) for the first page. A cursor the server did not issue is rejected with a `VALIDATION_ERROR` error event. Treat it as opaque: servers encode it as unpadded base64url of `<RFC 3339 updatedAt, full precision>|<conversationId>` today, and that may change.

query.description: Server-side search. Keeps only conversations where this text (trimmed; matched case-insensitively as a substring) appears in the conversation's meaningful name (an auto-title or rename, never the default `Session …` placeholder) or in the text of its first inbound message. Blank means no filter. It narrows the caller's scope and never widens it.

Response.title: ListConversationsResponse
Response.description: Data payload carried in the `immediate_response` event.

conversations.description: One page of conversations, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor naming the last conversation in this page. Pass it (with the same `query`) as the next request's `cursor`. Non-null if and only if `hasMore` is true. Servers that predate paging omit it.

hasMore.description: True if more conversations follow this page. Servers that predate paging omit it; treat absence as false.

ConversationListItem.title: ConversationListItem
ConversationListItem.description: One sidebar row: enough to render the entry and resume the conversation on click.

title.description: The conversation's meaningful name, else a truncated preview of its first inbound message, else its default name.

messageCount.description: Number of messages in the conversation.
